US9589231B2.description: A patent publication titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" describing a method and system for diagnosis assistance using embedding-based similarity between medical cases and experts.

Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.entity_name: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.description: The title of the patent publication US9589231B2, describing a network-based approach to assisting medical diagnosis.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method that exploits similarity between a new medical case and existing medical cases and experts embedded in a common embedding space, supporting query-by-cases and query-by-experts.

Embedding Space.description: A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so their similarity can be computed.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used as candidates when a query-for-cases is selected.

Experts.description: A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profile, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases.

Requester.description: The user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.

Medical Ontology.description: An ontology comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, used to compute multidimensional representations of medical cases and experts, with each concept corresponding to a dimension.

Unified Medical Language System.description: The medical ontology on which the medical ontology used for embedding is based.

Matrix Of Proximities.description: A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of the new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.

Human Body Parts.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the medical ontology.

Biological Functions.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the medical ontology.

Medical Conditions.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the medical ontology.

Pharmacological Substances.description: One of the categories of concepts included in the medical ontology.

Expert Profile.description: Information associated with an expert, used as a basis for embedding the expert in the embedding space.

Coded Medical Procedures.description: Medical procedures performed by an expert, used as a basis for embedding the expert in the embedding space.

Expert Articles.description: Articles authored by an expert, used as a basis for embedding the expert in the embedding space.

Expert Availability.description: An attribute of an expert that, along with rating and follower count, may be used when returning the subset of experts for a query-for-experts.

Expert Rating.description: A rating of an expert that may be used when returning the subset of experts for a query-for-experts.

Expert Followers.description: The number of followers of an expert among users of the system, which may be used when returning the subset of experts for a query-for-experts.

Public Database.description: A database from which documents may be returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and documents embedded in the embedding space when a query-for-cases is selected.

Patient Records.description: A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.

Laboratory Test Results.description: A type of record that may be included in the plurality of records making up the new medical case.

Medical Images.description: A type of record that may be included in the plurality of records making up the new medical case.

Symptom Descriptions.description: A type of record that may be included in the plurality of records making up the new medical case.

Patient Monitor Results.description: A type of record that may be included in the plurality of records making up the new medical case.

Diagnoses.description: A type of record that may be included in the plurality of records making up the new medical case.

Prescribed Medications And Treatments.description: A type of record that may be included in the plurality of records making up the new medical case.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.

Computer Program Product.description: A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

Computer Processor.description: A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets of cases or experts, and computing the query cost.

Payment To Expert.description: A provision for making a payment to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when a query-for-experts is selected.

Requester.description: A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from a plurality of query types.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester for which a diagnosis is sought, embedded in an embedding space.

Embedding Space.description: A multidimensional space in which existing medical cases, experts, and new medical cases are represented as multidimensional embeddings.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously stored medical cases embedded in the embedding space, used for similarity comparison.

Experts.description: A set of experts embedded in the embedding space who can be matched to a new case and attempt to provide a diagnosis.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that returns a subset of existing cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from the cost for a query-for-cases.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory storing instructions and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions to assist diagnosis.

Processor.description: A component in communication with the memory for executing the stored instructions.

Memory.description: A component that stores instructions for receiving queries, embedding cases, providing query types, and returning subsets of cases or experts.

Network.description: A network comprising a diagnosis assistance system and a set of user devices for linking requesters and experts with the system.

User Devices.description: A set of devices for linking requesters and experts with the diagnosis assistance system.

Diagnosis.description: The determination sought for a new medical case, which an expert attempts to provide.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A representation of a medical case or expert generated in the embedding space.

Query-By-Cases.description: A query type available at a first cost that identifies a subset of existing cases based on similarity of multidimensional representations.

Query-By-Experts.description: A query type available at a second cost, higher than the first cost, that identifies a subset of experts based on similarity of multidimensional representations.
